text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During the morning assembly, Ms. Kashimoto wastes no time criticizing the staff and students of Tracen for being undisciplined.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She goes on to say that she will implement Operation Oversight, a program that will oversee everything from the students' training to their meals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not only that, but she also suspends the Unity Cup, claiming that team activities would only lead to dangerous, irrational decisions driven by emotion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her announcements are met with booing. Taiki Shuttle complains that she's being too harsh, but her argument is promptly shot down.
